detail.longDescription: I think the Mastodon crowd skews older, so maybe we all remember this, but back in the 2010s we had Mathgen ( https:// thatsmathematics.com/mathgen/ ), which would create a randomly-generated pseudomathematical paper with your name on it. If you missed out on this at the time you can still try it now. The fact that some people now swear a bigger version of this can do math is wild. # math # mathematics # Mathgen # NoAI # AI # Perl # FOSS # research # humor # academia # TeXLaTeX
